full_page.content:
1951, December 23
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal message by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
(Message penned on the back of a printed copy of Christopher Notes - the "great movement" he refers to)
December 23rd 1951.
God bless you Dear Brother Pat.
I hope you're in this great movement. There 7 of us her and each gets a copy. .... . 4 :p.m. Br. Owen just phoned from Conley in Chicago. Coming to St. Felix to-night.
Best wishes for Blessed Christmas to all - with perseverence in God's holy grace to the end. - God bless all.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. C.
